content.document_title: ESC Committee for Practice Guidelines 2018-2020 - Declarations of Interest
content.description: Report listing declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year (calls conducted during development period up to and including 2019).

Declarations.2018: Financial Declaration: Direct personal payment (speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc.) from healthcare industry. - Abbott: Surgical Valves.
Declarations.2019: Financial Declaration: Travel and meeting support from healthcare industry, independent of the above activities. - Medtronic: Cardiothoracic Surgery.

entries.Declaration: Financial Declaration: Payment to department/institution for personal services (speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc.) from healthcare industry. - Novartis: antihypertensive drugs. - Alnylam: antihypertensive drugs. Research funding (personal): - British Heart Foundation: Hypertension research. - Medical Research Council, UK: Hypertension research. Other Positions of Influence: Membership/affiliation in political or advocacy groups in cardiology (e.g., American Heart Association, International Society of Hypertension, British Irish Hypertension Society).
